H3: AE is dominated by catheter/device friction (strongest alternative)

attacks.attack: The fracture/friction AE frequency ranges are estimated, not measured. Real fracture AE may overlap with friction AE in frequency.
attacks.countermeasure: The 10x frequency separation is based on AE literature (fracture AE is typically higher frequency than friction). But this is an assumption, not a measurement.

attacks.attack: The model assumes binary fracture/no-fracture. Real clot-device interaction is a spectrum.
attacks.countermeasure: The binary model is a simplification for discrimination testing. A continuous damage model would be more realistic but is Level 4+ work.
